comparisons.name: system-preferences-light
comparisons.description: The whole account header of System Preferences, Aqua. The picture and the two destinations' artwork are masked: the example draws stand-in blocks, not the tennis ball or Apple's icons.

comparisons.name: system-preferences-light-masked
comparisons.description: As system-preferences-light with the name, the subtitle and the captions masked too, which are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms: scores the band and its separator.

comparisons.name: system-preferences-dark
comparisons.description: The whole account header of System Preferences, Dark Aqua. The picture and the two destinations' artwork are masked: the example draws stand-in blocks, not the tennis ball or Apple's icons.

comparisons.name: system-preferences-dark-masked
comparisons.description: As system-preferences-dark with the name, the subtitle and the captions masked too, which are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms: scores the band and its separator. What remains is the Dark Aqua window's own lighter edge, half a point wide at each end of the crop, which belongs to the window and not to the header.
